why: The in-listing test, gone: og:image names a file the build never emitted -- renamed in public/, or dropped -- and the checker passes, so the deploy ships a card URL that answers 404. Pages caches that 404 for four hours (measured on this site, issue #973), so the mistake outlives its fix. Both the unit case and the CLI case for a missing share image see it.
killedBy: share image portability catches an og:image whose file the build did not emit
the CLI runs both checkers over a real directory exits non-zero when only the SHARE IMAGE is missing (issue #973)
